request.prompt:
You are a text-only source-entailment auditor. The source records are authoritative about their limited annotation meanings, NOT proof that the video visibly shows a fact. Compare the proposed QA and the separate blind answer with the exact source contract. Return JSON only. Verify every claim against its cited source_ids. Reject added receivers, causes, required corrections, tool-tip subtype, torque, whole-device completion, or mandatory order not explicitly sourced. Observed starts do not establish completion or prescribed order. ASR=-1 does not imply operator anomaly; an active segment alone may not prove unfinished physical installation. Keep ALL anomaly attributes in a multi-label answer. Questions must not leak their answer, must agree with the MCQ proposition, and each option must be mutually exclusive at the requested scope. A negative yes/no answer may be semantically equivalent to a positive description; compare meaning, not phrasing. If blind answer is uncertain or omits a requested attribute, blind_matches_gt=false. Never infer visual quality yourself.
Return exactly {"source_entails_answer":boolean,"claims_entailed":boolean,"question_preserves_scope":boolean,"open_mcq_equivalent":boolean,"no_answer_leakage":boolean,"unique_correct_option":boolean,"correct_option_index":integer,"blind_matches_gt":boolean,"unsupported_claims":[string],"reason":string}.
correct_option_index is zero based. reason <=60 words; unsupported_claims list the precise unsupported claims, empty only if none. No chain-of-thought.

payload.question_proposition: What types of error occurred while I was aligning the tool with my right hand?
payload.mcq_question_proposition: Which option gives the complete set of error types while I was aligning the tool with my right hand?

facts.scope: all source ATR attributes for this hand/action only; no physical mechanism inferred

forbidden_claims: A unique mandatory order inferred from illustration
An operator mistake inferred from ASR=-1
Unsourced cause, correction, receiver, torque or fine alignment
Dropping any GT anomaly attribute from a multi-label answer

proposed_qa.open_question: What types of error occurred while I was aligning the tool with my right hand?
proposed_qa.answer: Object handling and procedural errors occurred during the alignment action.
proposed_qa.mcq_question: Which option gives the complete set of error types while I was aligning the tool with my right hand?
proposed_qa.limitation: Frames show the alignment action but do not visually distinguish specific error categories like handling or procedural without source data.

claims.claim: Object handling and procedural errors occurred while aligning the tool with the right hand.

blind_answer.answer: No visible error occurred; the tool was aligned and used consistently across frames.
blind_answer.observation: The person holds a red-handled screwdriver and applies it to a black component without visible misalignment or slip.
blind_answer.limitation: Cannot confirm internal fit or torque; only external alignment is visible.

result.reason: Source s0/s2 confirms handling/procedural errors. Blind answer denies errors, contradicting source. Question scope matches source constraints.

Blind answer denies errors, contradicting source. Question scope matches source constraints."}
